notes.title: 4:58 A.M. Dossier
notes.content:
[i]What is a thing’s worth? Not the sculptor’s trembling hymn to “perfection”--
but how it laughs as it is thrown into the marketplace’s maw,
chewed by the teeth of the herd, corroded by their doubt.
Let your creation be a storm that begs the lightning’s strike,
a cliff that dares the tide to gnash its bones to sand.
Only the thing that survives the mob’s holy no--
*its cracks packed with their spit, its spine bent by their why**--
earns the right to roar:
“Behold what cannot be killed!”[/i]

[b]Listen, everybody.[/b]

Enough of this nonsense. SHORE has been demo-less long enough. There’s only one stop left before the free public demo -- but this stop is even more important. We’re looking for brave warriors:
- RPG-lovers
- Shore-walkers
- Disco OGs
- Pathologic pilgrims (RIP Nikolai)
- Mouthwashers
- Everyone else

You should be honest, love RPGs, and be handsome.

We’ll launch a Discord server close to that time, but you can queue through the Community Hub or DM us on Twitter already.

[b]Walk carefully. Stay tuned.[/b]
